Name: Ahimelech, Son of Abiathar
Summary: Ahimelech, son of Abiathar, is named among David's chief officers as priest alongside Zadok in the list of David's administration.
KeyStory: Ahimelech son of Abiathar served as priest in David's settled kingdom.
RelatedPeople: Abiathar, Son of Ahimelech; Zadok, Son of Ahitub; Abiathar, Priest
LifeLesson: A son can inherit his father's office and serve it quietly.
